Article 3
The Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence aims to:
a. prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children;
b. protect Women and provide services to Women and Child Victims of Acts of Violence; and
c. empower Women and Child Victims of Acts of Violence.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is North Gorontalo Regency (Kabupaten Gorontalo Utara).
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of North Gorontalo.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the regional head and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region.
6. Forum for the Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FP2ATK is a forum established based on this Regional Regulation whose membership comes from relevant agencies and communities concerned with protection from acts of violence.
7. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 (eighteen) years of age, including a child still in the womb.
8. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and community organizations and/or associations.
9. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband and wife and their child, or father and his child, or mother and her child, or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
10. Every person is an individual person or corporation.
11. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of freedom.
12. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
13. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
14. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
15. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will, is, or has occurred.
16. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, as well as receive protection from violence and discrimination.
17. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development.
18. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals.
19. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is, or has occurred.
20. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field.
21. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of violence in the household to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically.
22. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter referred to as P2TP2A is an integrated service provider institution for victims established by the Regional Government.

Article 12
Paragraph (1)
Letter a What is meant by "complaint services" is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families or the community.
Letter b What is meant by "health services" are efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.
Letter c What is meant by "counseling" is a process of providing objective and complete information, carried out systematically with interpersonal communication guidance, counseling techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge aimed at helping a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine solutions or efforts to overcome these problems.
Letter d What is meant by "spiritual guidance" is a form of activity in which there is a process of spiritual guidance and development for humans so that it can provide tranquility, peace and coolness of heart to humans by constantly providing encouragement and motivation to remain patient, trust in God and continue to carry out their obligations.
Letter e What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" are services aimed at restoring and developing the abilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.
Letter f What is meant by "legal aid and assistance services" are legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children that are gender sensitive.
Letter g What is meant by "repatriation and reintegration" are efforts to return women and children victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point, or from the receiving area to the area of origin.

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute a violation of human rights; therefore, their self-respect and dignity must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and inherent nature, without discrimination. In order to prevent and address violence against women and children in North Gorontalo Regency so that they avoid violence, threats of violence, torture, or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation. Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts/measures at the Regional level; therefore, institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee their implementation. Regional Regulations regulate protection efforts/measures for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in North Gorontalo Regency

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute a violation of human rights; therefore, their self-respect and dignity must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and inherent nature, without discrimination. In order to prevent and address violence against women and children in North Gorontalo Regency so that they avoid violence, threats of violence, torture, or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation. Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts/measures at the Regional level; therefore, institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee their implementation. Regional Regulations regulate protection efforts/measures for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in North Gorontalo Regency

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute a violation of human rights; therefore, their self-respect and dignity must be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and inherent nature, without discrimination. In order to prevent and address violence against women and children in North Gorontalo Regency so that they avoid violence, threats of violence, torture, or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation. Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts/measures at the Regional level; therefore, institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee their implementation. Regional Regulations regulate protection efforts/measures for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in North Gorontalo Regency
